checks.name: Three initial members and seeded combat maps join a connected shop/recruit route
Keyboard enters shop; purchases charge exact prices and limited stock becomes unavailable
Reload during a visit retains money, bag and remaining stock without rerolling
Equip, remove and re-equip conserve one copy of the item and its single slot
Held item reaches combat and a real victory grants the reward once
Outside-combat healing previews and consumes once; reload retains the healed HP
Optional early substitution cancels without charge and restores its exact trigger focus
Recruitment adds new identities, limits each offer to one use and blocks insufficient money
Six allies deploy with separate sprites, complete initiative and a usable mobile HUD
Real casualties leave the active team and cannot be selected for healing after reload
Replacement preview and cancellation/Escape preserve roster, offer, equipment and money
Confirmed replacement charges once, returns gear and preserves the new member after reload
Six real combats reach the provisional final with exactly six rewards and persistent losses
Version-1 ongoing fight migrates with its original backup and preserves battle progress
A corrupted economic total is rejected without overwriting the save until explicit discard
Shop and bag support long seeds, native controls, keyboard focus and mobile without overflow
A stale shopping tab cannot replace the latest run or debit its money
Gameplay visits have no JavaScript errors or external asset requests

syntheticFixtures: Full-roster replacement only; gameplay encounters and final are reached with legal real commands.
